records.finding: CORRECTION: the earlier search hit 'Beleidsregels kamerverhuur en woningsplitsen' CVDR718239 belongs to municipality Hoorn, not Gouda. It is removed completely from the Gouda evidence set. Current Gouda municipal information instead states that ordinary dwellings are generally for one household; hospitaverhuur of at most 2 rooms to at most 2 households is permit-free if the owner lives and is BRP-registered at the address; other kamergewijze verhuur generally requires an omgevingsvergunning and is assessed against Gouda-specific conditions. Current Omgevingsplan Gouda CVDR696342 is effective from 04-12-2025 and remains the controlling address-specific source.

Huisvestingsverordening gemeente Harderwijk 2026 is current from 01-01-2026 and explicitly states that the municipality currently does NOT use the Huisvestingswet powers to make withdrawal, merging, conversion, woningvorming or splitting of the housing stock permit-required. Onzelfstandige woonruimte is also excluded from the general housing-permit allocation requirement. This does not remove possible Omgevingsplan/Omgevingswet permission requirements; those remain a separate spatial check.
